hints.content: When Harry hadn't paid any of his debt, his debt was the size of his loan. So the size of Harry's loan is equal to the value of $D$ when $t=0$.
The size of Harry's loan is $\$9000$.

question.content:
Harry took a loan from the bank.

$D$ represents Harry's remaining debt (in dollars) after $t$ months.

$D=-200t+9000$

**What was the size of Harry's loan?**

$\$$[[☃ numeric-input 1]]
